about: Application rules (platform_core/rules.py). An owner marks the CarePath coding standards as rules; for each seeded ticket that breaks one of them (demo-artifacts/demo-kit/seeded-gaps.md), the statement it breaks. The scorecard asks rules.applicable for each ticket as Code Factory's plan review asks it - the ticket's title and description - and counts the expected rule among those shown, and in first place. The other seeded tickets break no coding-standard rule; what they are shown is counted, not judged. Labelled by hand from the gaps document, never from the ranking's output.

tickets.CARE-412: Collections are bounded at the server
tickets.CARE-418: Nothing with a name goes in a log
